Satellite ThaiIOT
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Entity name The Navaminda Kasatriyadhiraj Royal Thai Air Force Academy
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters Thailand
Oneliner

Receive uplink data via LoRa module and private LoRaWAN-server to store data and then use S-band transceiver to downlink the data to ground station.
Description

Use UHF receiver to obtain sensors’ data from the end devices on ground then downlink data to the ground station via non-amateur s-band frequency (2250 MHz).

The mission of this project is to build 3U cubesat with store and forward server payload to demonstrate the store and forward technology by storing the data from the remote areas using the long distance and low power devices and forwarding the payload data by using high speed communication through S-band transmitter.

Worldwide amateur operators can participate in this mission by using the amateur radio band end devices on ground to send the necessary sensor data to THAIIOT. That way, we can prove that the participated amateur operators’ devices are working properly for their future store and forward mission.
